de: Die Gemeinde besteht aus drei verschiedenen Teilen (North Delta, Ladner und Tsawwassen), weshalb ein Mietwagen sehr empfehlenswert ist.
Wenn Sie nach Vancouver Island reisen, buchen Sie Ihre Tsawwassen-Fährtickets frühzeitig, besonders an Sommerwochenenden.
Besuchen Sie das Vogelschutzgebiet George C. Reifel am Morgen, aber denken Sie daran, Tickets vorab online zu reservieren.
Das Wetter kann unbeständig sein; tragen Sie mehrere Schichten, besonders in der Nähe der windigen Boundary Bay.
hu: A település három különálló részből áll (North Delta, Ladner és Tsawwassen), így a közlekedéshez erősen ajánlott az autóbérlés.
Ha a Vancouver-szigetre utazol, jó előre foglald le a kompjegyet Tsawwassenben, különösen a nyári hétvégéken.
Látogass el a George C. Reifel Madárvédelmi Területre reggel, de ne feledd, hogy a jegyeket előre online kell lefoglalni.
Az időjárás változékony lehet; öltözz rétegesen, főleg ha a szeles Boundary Bay környékén sétálsz.
ro: Municipalitatea este formată din trei comunități distincte (North Delta, Ladner și Tsawwassen), așa că o mașină este foarte recomandată pentru deplasare.
Dacă călătoriți spre Insula Vancouver, rezervați-vă biletele de feribot din Tsawwassen cu mult timp înainte, mai ales în weekendurile de vară.
Vizitați Sanctuarul de Păsări Migratoare George C. Reifel dimineața, dar rețineți că trebuie să rezervați biletele online în prealabil.
Vremea poate fi schimbătoare; îmbrăcați-vă în straturi, mai ales când vă plimbați pe lângă vântoasa Boundary Bay.
en: The municipality consists of three distinct communities (North Delta, Ladner, and Tsawwassen), so a car is highly recommended for getting around.
If traveling to Vancouver Island, book your Tsawwassen ferry tickets well in advance, especially during summer weekends.
Visit the George C. Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary in the morning, but remember you must pre-book your tickets online.
Weather can be changeable; dress in layers, especially when walking near Boundary Bay where the wind picks up.

de.name: Frische Meeresfrüchte
de.tip: Probieren Sie Fish and Chips oder Muschelsuppe in den kleinen Restaurants in Ladner Village.

de.name: Bauernhofprodukte
de.tip: Fahren Sie nach Westham Island, um im Sommer frische Beeren und Honig direkt an den Ständen zu kaufen.

de.name: Asiatische Küche
de.tip: In North Delta finden Sie entlang der Scott Road ausgezeichnete indische Restaurants und Süßwarenläden.

hu.name: Friss tengeri herkentyűk
hu.tip: Kóstold meg a helyi fish and chips-et vagy a kagylólevest a Ladner Village éttermeiben.

hu.name: Tanyasi termékek
hu.tip: Látogass el a Westham-szigetre, ahol nyáron friss bogyós gyümölcsöket és mézet vehetsz közvetlenül a termelőktől.

hu.name: Ázsiai konyha
hu.tip: North Delta kiváló, autentikus indiai éttermeket és édességboltokat kínál a Scott Road mentén.

ro.name: Fructe de mare proaspete
ro.tip: Încercați fish and chips sau supa de scoici la restaurantele din Ladner Village.

ro.name: Produse agricole
ro.tip: Mergeți pe Insula Westham vara pentru a cumpăra fructe de pădure proaspete și miere direct de la fermieri.

ro.name: Bucătărie asiatică
ro.tip: North Delta oferă restaurante indiene autentice și cofetării excelente de-a lungul Scott Road.

en.name: Fresh Seafood
en.tip: Try local fish and chips or clam chowder at the eateries in Ladner Village.

en.name: Farm Produce
en.tip: Head to Westham Island to buy fresh berries and local honey directly from the farm stands in summer.

en.name: Asian Cuisine
en.tip: North Delta offers excellent authentic Indian restaurants and sweet shops along Scott Road.

de.name: Tsawwassen Mills
de.tip: Ein riesiges Outlet-Center mit vielen Marken, ideal für einen Einkaufsbummel an einem regnerischen Tag.

de.name: Ladner Village Market
de.tip: Ein lebhafter Freiluftmarkt, der an ausgewählten Sommersonntagen stattfindet und lokales Handwerk bietet.

hu.name: Tsawwassen Mills
hu.tip: Egy hatalmas outlet bevásárlóközpont márkás üzletekkel, tökéletes program egy esős napra.

hu.name: Ladner Village Market
hu.tip: Egy nyüzsgő szabadtéri piac nyári vasárnapokon, ahol helyi kézművesek és ételárusok portékáiból válogathatsz.

ro.name: Tsawwassen Mills
ro.tip: Un mall outlet masiv cu magazine de marcă, perfect pentru o sesiune de cumpărături într-o zi ploioasă.

ro.name: Ladner Village Market
ro.tip: Un piept în aer liber animat, deschis în anumite duminici de vară, cu artizani locali și vânzători de mâncare.

en.name: Tsawwassen Mills
en.tip: A massive outlet mall offering brand-name stores, perfect for a rainy day shopping spree.

en.name: Ladner Village Market
en.tip: A lively open-air market operating on select Sundays in summer, featuring local artisans and food vendors.

de.name: Centennial Beach
de.tip: Genießen Sie einen ruhigen Spaziergang entlang der sandigen Wattflächen des Boundary Bay Regional Park.

de.name: Watershed Park
de.tip: Deltas größter Park bietet kilometerlange, schattige Wander- und Radwege durch dichten Wald.

hu.name: Centennial Beach
hu.tip: Tegyél egy békés sétát a Boundary Bay Regional Park homokos partjain, amely apálykor a legszebb.

hu.name: Watershed Park
hu.tip: Delta legnagyobb parkja kilométereken át kanyargó, árnyékos erdei séta- és kerékpárutakat kínál.

ro.name: Centennial Beach
ro.tip: Bucurați-vă de o plimbare liniștită de-a lungul bancurilor de nisip din Parcul Regional Boundary Bay.

ro.name: Watershed Park
ro.tip: Cel mai mare parc din Delta are kilometri de trasee umbrite pentru drumeții și ciclism printr-o pădure deasă.

en.name: Centennial Beach
en.tip: Enjoy a peaceful walk along the sandy tidal flats of Boundary Bay Regional Park, especially beautiful at low tide.

en.name: Watershed Park
en.tip: Delta's largest park features kilometers of quiet, shaded walking and biking trails through dense forest.
